title: WebM Cues placement changes request timing, not total work here

definition.title: WebM Cues placement changes request timing, not total work here
definition.source_excerpt: Under a local server that caps each HTTP Range response at 256 KiB: Tail Cues caused a small 1,519-byte tail fetch during metadata and more bytes at seek time; front Cues pulled more early and less later. Total traffic differs by only 0.19%. This looks like a latency/request-shaping policy rather than a byte-saving optimization in this workload.
